newsitem.title: USA: PMT completes acquisition for cash, stock.
newsitem.headline: PMT completes acquisition for cash, stock.

text.p: Plasma & Materials Technologies Inc said it completed the acquisition of Electrotech Limited and Electrotech Equipments Limited for $75 million in cash and 5.6 million in newly issued Plasma & Materials stock.

To help finance the cash portion of the acquisition, on October 7, 1996 Plasma & Materials completed the sale of $86.25 million principal amount of 7-1/8 percent convertible Subordinated Notes Due 2001.

The Notes are convertible into common stock at a conversion price of $15.635 per share. In addition, the company has secured a $35 million working capital line of credit subject to borrowing base limitations, and obtained commitments for an additional funding of up to $6.25 million of subordinated indebtedness.

Chris Dobson, Electrotech's founder and chairman, is PMT's chairman of the board. John Rollwagen, previously PMT's chairman, will step down as chairman but remain a member of the board of directors. Greg Campbell will continue to be chief executive officer of PMT and Nigel Wheeler, who was Electrotech's chief executive officer, is now president, chief operating officer, and a board member of PMT.
